name: orc_double_stage_kirchstockach
title: Double-stage (HT + LT series) ORC power plant Kirchstockach, design point
summary: Design point of the Kirchstockach geothermal plant: two R245fa ORC cycles (HT 13.85 bar, LT 5.97 bar) in series on the 135.1 degC brine, air-cooled condensers sized by an imposed pinch, brine branch split and mixing, gross/net power and second-law efficiencies.

origin.license: No LICENSE file in the original (README: shared for educational use); credited and linked

verification.summary: The source notebook complete_ORC.ipynb was re-run headless (TESPy 0.11.3, CoolProp, repo commit 85a2362b) and all 27 quantities of its validation table agree with the CoolSolve solution within 1.9e-8 relative (worst, on T_07); air mass flows and brine exergy agree as well. Notebook itself validated against Table 3 of Heberle et al. 2015.
verification.reference: Re-run of tespy/ORC_offdesign/complete_ORC.ipynb (KCORC_summer_school @ 85a2362b); Heberle, Jahrfeld, Brueggemann 2015, Table 3
verification.notes: vs notebook re-run: worst 1.9e-8 relative over the 27 validation-table quantities (same CoolProp backend). vs Heberle 2015 Table 3: gross power 5468.6 vs 5309.6 kW (+3.0%), the deviation the notebook itself documents (property backend, pinch at the dew-point boundary).

related_external: Heberle, Jahrfeld, Brueggemann 2015, Proceedings World Geothermal Congress, paper 26002 (double-stage ORC Kirchstockach)
